— Ralph Waldo Emerson
en-US.description:
**Ralph Waldo Emerson · Essays · Heroism, §7**

The front preserves the quotation from the cited edition. Commentary, questions and connections are editorial.

### Context

Emerson describes character resisting falsehood and wrong.

### A present-day example · editorial commentary

Suppose you find an arithmetic error in a report everyone has accepted. Checking the source data and asking for a correction illustrates acting on reasons before gaining approval. If someone supplies new data, the calculation still needs reconsideration. In this editorial example, self-trust means owning and explaining a judgment rather than declaring it infallible. Holding to a principle and acknowledging an error can belong to the same responsible action.

### A perspective

Self-trust can mean relying on principle despite disapproval.

### Reflect

Which principle would you keep without applause?

### Keep in mind

Confidence does not guarantee sound judgment.

### Source quotation

> Self-trust is the essence of heroism.

### Source

[Essays](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/16643/16643-h/16643-h.htm) · Heroism, §7

English original; Edna H. L. Turpin selection, Charles E. Merrill, 1907

### 오늘의 사례로 읽기 · 편집 해설

en-US.title:
The characteristic of a genuine heroism is its persistency.
— Ralph Waldo Emerson
en-US.description:
**Ralph Waldo Emerson · Essays · Heroism, §14**

The front preserves the quotation from the cited edition. Commentary, questions and connections are editorial.

### Context

Emerson contrasts commitment with bursts of generosity.

### A present-day example · editorial commentary

After first proposing a more accessible building entrance, someone gathers users’ views and follows up with those responsible. Less visible actions can connect the initial statement to possible change. If the proposed method proves unhelpful to users, however, it needs revision. This editorial scenario distinguishes commitment to a purpose from attachment to one method. It does not suggest that an individual’s persistence can remove every institutional or physical barrier alone.

### A perspective

Courage can continue after the dramatic moment.

### Reflect

What action will follow your initial resolve?

### Keep in mind

Changed circumstances may require revising a commitment.

### Source quotation

> The characteristic of a genuine heroism is its persistency.

### Source

[Essays](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/16643/16643-h/16643-h.htm) · Heroism, §14

English original; Edna H. L. Turpin selection, Charles E. Merrill, 1907

### 文脈

続く決意を一時の寛大さと区別する。

### 今日の事例で読む・編集解説

建物入口の利用しづらさを改善しようと提案した後、利用者の意見を集め、担当者に進捗を確認するとする。目立たない継続行動が最初の発言を変化につなぎうる。ただし方法が利用者の役に立たないと分かれば改める必要がある。この編集例は目的への継続と手段への固執を区別する。一人の粘り強さだけで制度的・物理的障壁がすべてなくなるとはいわない。

### 読みの視点

勇気は劇的な瞬間の後の行動にもある。

### 自分への問い

最初の決意の後に何を続けるか。

### 注意点

状況が変われば決意も見直す必要がある。

### 出典の原文

> The characteristic of a genuine heroism is its persistency.

### 出典

[Essays](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/16643/16643-h/16643-h.htm) · Heroism, §14

English original; Edna H. L. Turpin selection, Charles E. Merrill, 1907

### 從今日案例閱讀・編輯解說

提出改善建築入口的無障礙問題後，繼續收集使用者意見並向負責者追蹤，較不顯眼的行動才可能把最初表態連到改變。但若方法實際無益於使用者，就須調整。這個編輯情境區分對目的的持續承擔與對單一手段的執著，也不主張一個人的毅力足以獨自移除所有制度或實體障礙。

### 맥락

### 오늘의 사례로 읽기 · 편집 해설

새 행사를 자신 있게 시작하자는 사람과 우천 시 장소를 먼저 확보하자는 사람은 반드시 서로 반대편에 있는 것이 아니다. 추진하려는 마음과 취소 조건을 확인하는 능력은 다른 역할을 한다. 이 편집 예시에서는 대안 장소와 결정 시점을 정한 뒤 실행할 수 있다. 위험을 점검한다고 용기가 없는 것도 아니고, 자신감이 크다고 점검을 마친 것도 아니다. 다만 준비로 모든 불확실성이 사라지는 것은 아니다.

This is well to be weighed; that boldness is ever blind; for it seeth not danger, and inconveniences.
— Francis Bacon
en-US.description:
**Francis Bacon · Essays, or Counsels Civil and Moral · Of Boldness, final paragraph**

The front preserves the quotation from the cited edition. Commentary, questions and connections are editorial.

### Context

Bacon warns that bold political actors overlook danger.

### A present-day example · editorial commentary

An enthusiastic organizer and someone asking for a rain plan need not be opponents. Willingness to act and the ability to identify cancellation conditions serve different roles. In this editorial scenario, agreeing on an alternative venue and a decision time can support action. Checking risks does not establish cowardice, just as confidence does not establish that checking is complete. Preparation can make a choice more informed without removing every uncertainty.

### A perspective

Energy and risk awareness deserve separate checks.

### Reflect

Which risk might confidence conceal?

### Keep in mind

Not every courageous act is reckless.

### Source quotation

> This is well to be weighed; that boldness is ever blind; for it seeth not danger, and inconveniences.

### Source

[Essays, or Counsels Civil and Moral](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/575/575-h/575-h.htm) · Of Boldness, final paragraph

English original, final collection 1625; Project Gutenberg \#575 transcription

### 文脈

政治で大胆な人が危険を見落とすと警告する。

### 今日の事例で読む・編集解説

行事を積極的に進めたい人と雨天時の場所を確認したい人は、必ずしも対立しない。行動への意欲と中止条件を見極める力は異なる役割を持つ。この編集例では代替会場と判断時刻を決めて実行できる。危険を調べることは臆病の証明ではなく、自信は確認済みの証明でもない。準備は判断を助けても不確実性をすべてなくすわけではない。

### 読みの視点

推進力と危険への認識を別々に点検できる。

### 自分への問い

自信のために見落とす危険は何か。

### 注意点

すべての勇気を無謀とは言えない。

### 出典の原文

> This is well to be weighed; that boldness is ever blind; for it seeth not danger, and inconveniences.

### 出典

挑選首次活動的夥伴時，最大聲保證成功不一定最能證明準備充分。仔細確認物品、分工與出問題時聯絡對象的人，也能支持執行。這個編輯例子的謹慎，是釐清決策所需條件，不是無限延期。先約定檢查項目與行動時間，有助區分有用準備和永遠無法進入行動的審查。

### 閱讀觀點

謹慎可以支撐勇氣。

### 自我提問

你會與誰在行動前檢視計畫？

### 注意事項

這不是支持無止境規劃而不實行。

### 맥락

군대를 맡는다면 누구와 함께할지 묻자 무모함을 거부한다.

### 오늘의 사례로 읽기 · 편집 해설

처음 함께 행사를 준비할 사람을 고를 때 가장 큰소리로 성공을 장담하는 사람만 찾을 필요는 없다. 필요한 물품과 담당자, 일이 어긋났을 때 연락할 사람을 차분히 확인하는 동료가 실행에 도움을 줄 수 있다. 이 편집 예시에서 신중함은 결정을 미루는 태도가 아니라 결정에 필요한 점을 확인하는 역할이다. 확인 항목과 실행 시점을 합의하면 검토가 끝없이 늘어나는 것도 피할 수 있다.

### 읽는 관점

신중함은 용기를 지탱할 수 있다.

### 나에게 묻기

실행 전에 누구와 계획을 점검할 것인가?

끝없는 검토로 실행을 피하라는 말은 아니다.
